classification.difficultyReason: Identify opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse in rotated numeric and symbolic triangles, then place their labels into the three taught ratios. The completed example and early fraction scaffolds support this direct application.

content.prompt: Label the sides, then write the ratios $\sin\theta$, $\cos\theta$, $\tan\theta$.
